content:
The Freiburg Institute for Advanced Studies (FRIAS) is calling for fellowship applications. Fellowships fund longer-term research stays in Freiburg, free of teaching and admin, and in a rather agreeable environment. This could be an ideal setting to push a formalization project forward. FRIAS is explicitly cross-disciplinary, and mathematics has long been well represented.

Applications close 18 September 2026. If this interests you and you'd like a contact on the ground in Freiburg, feel free to message me. Active formalizers in Freiburg include @Peter Pfaffelhuber and myself.

Details: https://uni-freiburg.de/frias/funding/frias-fellowship-programmes/
Can recommend! FRIAS is a very nice institute, Freiburg is a very nice town, and the people at the math institute are very nice mathematicians!
